policy: Working is reserved for exercised real operations and bounded scaffolds; never equals full Master Prompt completion. Existing sources take priority over this analysis.

sections.title: The premise: a civilisation shaped by beastkind
sections.unfulfilled: Magical ecology, beast citizens and everyday crafts have examples, but not scene-complete society.

sections.title: World scale and geography
sections.unfulfilled: Six continents and 29 biomes exist; detailed travel times, settlements and logistics are incomplete.

sections.title: Cosmology and planes
sections.unfulfilled: Realm teachings exist; actual planar law, divine limits, afterlife and entry rules are not implemented.

sections.title: History and historical causality
sections.unfulfilled: Source-dated rulers, competing archives, historical events and relic provenance incomplete.

sections.title: World state and simulation
sections.unfulfilled: Sixday/month changes and source-backed individual living-world behaviours are deterministic and persistent; this does not represent every citizen's hourly schedule, political consequence or whole-world population.

sections.title: A bestiary capable of supporting hundreds of thousands of species
sections.unfulfilled: Hundreds of thousands of addressable slots are not authored species histories or automatically safe encounter profiles.

sections.title: Individual beast records
sections.unfulfilled: Individual partner records exist; anatomy, ecology, sapience and wound models differ among records.

sections.title: Beast grades, levels and potential
sections.unfulfilled: Level/grade/potential have separate fields; species-specific caps and progression not generally completed.

sections.title: Beast abilities and techniques
sections.unfulfilled: Spell/Qi cost calculators work; verified ability/technique catalogues, learning and cooldowns incomplete.

sections.title: Beast evolution
sections.unfulfilled: Pre-authored evolution form is now mandatory for actual success; branching research, biological consequences and downstream ecology still need per-species content.

sections.title: Beast ecology
sections.unfulfilled: Conserved local materials, regional resources, some independent ecology and real off-screen animal behaviour/limited skill learning are tested, including across saved turns. Full species food webs, ecological populations, advanced reproduction, migration, seasons and climate remain incomplete.

sections.title: Beast intelligence and society
sections.unfulfilled: Rights and nonhuman polities are modeled; individual cultures/languages and autonomous beast courts not fully enacted.

sections.title: Taming is not one universal process
sections.unfulfilled: Voluntary consent/approach gates exist; diverse species-specific taming social protocols incomplete.

sections.title: Bond mechanics
sections.unfulfilled: Many bond dimensions, events and fractures work; persistent long-term behavioral agency still GM-led.

sections.title: Contracts and rights
sections.unfulfilled: Consent/load safeguards implemented; contracts, rights enforcement, case law and remedies still partial.

sections.title: Partnership and synchronisation
sections.unfulfilled: Ten-stage numeric readiness and consent are modeled; all joint techniques, feedback and true shared evolution are not.

sections.title: Humans are evolving supernatural organisms
sections.unfulfilled: Human abilities, evolution, mastery and traits now explicitly separated; full transformation not operational.

sections.title: Shared supernatural origin: the Origin Pattern
sections.unfulfilled: Shared Origin Pattern is canonical but has no complete biological simulation across humans and species.

sections.title: Power-system architecture
sections.unfulfilled: No universal power ladder; early path milestones executable; multidiscipline interference beyond first stages remains open.

sections.title: Meridian Cultivation and Meridian Evolution
sections.unfulfilled: Foundation/Awakening/Gate 1–108 practice scaffolding; Stage IV–IX breakthrough rites and many deviation treatments incomplete.

sections.title: Arcane Circle Architecture
sections.unfulfilled: Second Circle construction and its two genuinely earned channels now permit independently learned Ward + Spark in source-verified actual combat, with real casting dice and combined Mana costs. Other Second Circle spells, Circles III–IX, complete spell-learning catalogues, load/interference, geometry transitions and wider Arcane applications remain unfinished.

sections.title: Soul Cultivation and Soul Engineering
sections.unfulfilled: Phase I Soul Perception can now sense genuine nearby life-signs from source-attested animal encounters or recent real in-person human meetings (canonical and independent workers), with original check, energy and time. Metre-level city population scans, Soul Phases II–VII, consensual Soul Engineering, trauma repair, contracts and advanced resonance abilities remain unimplemented.

sections.title: Body Refinement and Physique Evolution
sections.unfulfilled: Earned Muscle-Tendon Cycle I now expresses its previously established M1 natural physical force through source-verified Strength-based mundane attacks in wound combat, without magnitude stacking or a mandatory beast partner. Later tissue/organ cycles, comprehensive physical injury tolerance, unarmed/natural reach and specialised transformations remain unimplemented.

sections.title: Beast-Origin and Lineage Arts
sections.unfulfilled: Integration load and rejection DC formulas exist; full eight-phase trait integration with safeguards not available in private runner.

sections.title: Rift Practice
sections.unfulfilled: Rift Sense training works; anchors, spatial transit and domain effects are not tested systems.

sections.title: Specialist disciplines
sections.unfulfilled: Craft, research, and distinct professions exist; not all specialist techniques and tools are executable.

sections.title: Sacred and divine traditions
sections.unfulfilled: Cultures and shrines exist; divine beings and binding blessing limits are not mechanically verified.

sections.title: Human evolutionary stages
sections.unfulfilled: Human evolution is distinct from discipline ranks but individual transformation crises/effects are not operational.

sections.title: Human attributes and multidimensional potential
sections.unfulfilled: Four detailed current capability domains and sealed independent potential dimensions; deeper clinical protocols and earned change remain partial.

sections.title: Human evolutionary forms and transformation
sections.unfulfilled: No unified duration/cost/injury/reversion pipeline for physical human transformation states.

sections.title: Independent humanity and beast-rejecting philosophies
sections.unfulfilled: Independent secular/anti-beast philosophy exists in lore; full career equivalence and legal conflict not complete.

sections.title: Beast-related professions
sections.unfulfilled: Professions represented; full qualifications, wages, apprenticeships and competency proofs missing.

sections.title: Guilds, academies, sects and organisations
sections.unfulfilled: 48 institutions with changing conditions, not complete curricula, access decisions or NPC leadership.

sections.title: Kingdoms, empires and noble families
sections.unfulfilled: 24 states and diplomacy/clocks; real military logistics, dynastic genealogy and peace-process logic missing.

sections.title: Economy and resource systems
sections.unfulfilled: An actual source-owned Orrin provisioner sells limited real stock for Scales; player-owned canonical goods can be voluntarily offered to a genuinely present human and accepted goods enter that person's private custody rather than becoming market stock. Broader production, livelihoods, property, bargaining, wage funding, contracts, credit and regional consumer demand remain incomplete. The 08:00–18:00 gift cutoff is still an acknowledged artificial rule on main until its separate guarded repair is merged.

sections.title: Laws and social systems
sections.unfulfilled: Regional rights and consent rules; procedural court trials and punishments unavailable.

sections.title: Competition culture
sections.unfulfilled: Events and contests exist in legacy prototype; judges, calendar and promotion/licence systems incomplete.

sections.title: Separate ranking systems
sections.unfulfilled: Independent score registers and Concord arithmetic; full qualification and ranking governance partial.

sections.title: The player is a person, not the centre of the world
sections.unfulfilled: Player freedom/civic presence are narration rules; NPC motivations not inferred mechanically.

sections.title: Character creation
sections.unfulfilled: Seeded male starts, backgrounds, family and date; universal demographic variability and examinations incomplete.

sections.title: Natural language and player personality
sections.unfulfilled: The GM interprets unrestricted natural-language intent; unknown actions are now returned honestly unresolved rather than falsely succeeded or rejected by legacy parser assumptions. A source-authenticated terrain footing/reading check can be precommitted and resolved once, but not every novel physical, social or supernatural action has a lawful numerical handoff. The engine does not own player dialogue or personality.

sections.title: NPC individuality
sections.unfulfilled: Individual generated workers have established regional background, profession, personal purpose, temperament, witnessed conversations, independent work offers/refusals and remembered concrete consequences. The GM still interprets voice, private nuance, culture and changing beliefs; fully general living relationships, agreements, legal promises and detailed hour-by-hour lives are not modelled.

sections.title: Beast personalities and communication
sections.unfulfilled: Source-backed independent animal responses, observed individual memory, habitat-linked searches and genuinely voluntary sapient contact are tested. Full species languages, autonomous nonhuman cultures, deep biographies, consent protocols and complete long-term relationships remain partial.

sections.title: Time and daily life
sections.unfulfilled: Actual clock, daylight, living-world sixday/month ticks and verified settlement/campsite rest exist. Authored public professionals have witnessed daytime availability; independent workers and named people have source-backed day schedules, not complete hourly personal routines. Weather variety, local transport, exposure, daily economics and many travel hazards remain partial.

sections.title: Actions and resolution
sections.unfulfilled: The d20 core, real actor ranks, one-use source-witnessed checks, world/time costs, refusals and bounded GM local-terrain preparation are tested; the GM still judges feasibility, and unknown consequential scenes cannot invent arbitrary DCs, staked rewards or hidden participants.

sections.title: Combat
sections.unfulfilled: Wounds, Ward and contested exchange tested; movement, spell legality, terrain and complete tactics partial.

sections.title: Quests, contracts and opportunities
sections.unfulfilled: Naturalists public field requests now lead through personally witnessed survey, independent guild review, funded approval and a real later site visit with risk, cancellation and measurable small ecological consequences. Diverse issuers, negotiation, wages, recurring occupations, contractual stakes and extensive opportunity outcomes remain unfinished.

sections.title: Training and progression
sections.unfulfilled: Training tracks and first power milestones now verified; specialisations, later paths and population careers partial.

sections.title: Injuries, health and recovery
sections.unfulfilled: The existing wound/recovery model now accepts genuinely scouted, hash-verified outdoor sleeping sites, without making dangerous sites safe or instantly curing serious injuries; advanced surgery, exposure, long-term rehabilitation and lasting critical injuries remain partial.

sections.title: Inventory, equipment and crafting
sections.unfulfilled: Atomic item conservation, source-owned limited goods, real purchase and handoffs, two authentic habitat material sources, native replanting, original poultice craft at either the Lumenfall Annex clinic or Morrowfen Crossing infirmary, plus bounded owned reed-indicator invention/repair share physical work and honest checks. All other recipes, diverse material properties and quality, comprehensive tools, equipment maintenance, working rights and broad creative object design remain partially GM-led or unavailable.

sections.title: Continuity ledger
sections.unfulfilled: Private Project chat play uses a public GitHub repository as code/checkpoint store. Disposable real Actions runs verified source-bound action → result/save → checkpoint → subsequent request pickup, stale refusal and original-roll recovery without reroll (see live verification report). A second ChatGPT chat was not separately opened; GitHub delivery failures and complete canon-world ledger coverage are not eliminated.

sections.title: Status interface
sections.unfulfilled: Compact player-known display; UI is client-authored, engine cannot guarantee animation/rendering across platforms.

sections.title: Narrative style
sections.unfulfilled: Naturalistic prose is a human-facing GM rule, not mechanistically testable.

sections.title: Player freedom
sections.unfulfilled: Player freedom is primarily a GM responsibility, not a command list. Unrecognised intentions are preserved without fictional mechanical rewards; source-supported local terrain can use a real precommitted check. Arbitrary novel combat, pathfinding, diplomacy, craft and power consequences are not automatically mechanically resolved by the JS runner.

sections.title: Build the world before beginning
sections.unfulfilled: Atlas/world generated prior to play but many local settlements, mysteries and citizens not authored.

sections.title: Character creation and opening
sections.unfulfilled: Independent seeded campaign, scene, date, companion/family possible; professional power enrolment not fully integrated.

sections.title: Final governing principles
sections.unfulfilled: Final governing principles require ongoing human GM judgement and truthful incomplete declarations.
